Thanks for booking your class visit. Here is the plan for the morning so you can brief the other adults before you travel.

- Meet our guide at the main ticket desk at ten.
- Leave coats and lunch bags in the labelled baskets.
- Start with the pottery gallery, where there is room for everyone to sit.
- Split into two groups for the handling session.
- Rejoin in the courtyard before lunch.

Photography without flash is welcome in the permanent galleries. The temporary exhibition has separate signs, which the guide will point out. If the weather is wet, we will use the studio for lunch instead of the courtyard. Let me know whether you want the shop included in the visit; some teachers prefer to go straight back to the bus.

Best,
Ionae
